exposure: Local intra-gestational sac methotrexate injection followed by dilation and curettage
Uterine artery embolization in combination with dilation and curettage
outcome: Success rate of treatment for cesarean scar pregnancies
cohort: 77 patients diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancies
finding: Local intra-gestational sac methotrexate injection followed by dilation and curettage is an effective and safe treatment for cesarean scar pregnancies that also drastically reduces the risks of complications.
